Jordan — thanks again for taking the call today. Quick written recap so we have a mutual action plan and a clear next step.

Recap (from our discussion)
- Primary use: realtime chat routing + task automation (customer support workflows).
- Latency target: p95 100ms for 1–2k concurrent sessions; peak bursts up to 3k qps.
- Data: customer PII will be processed; must meet SOC2 + regionally isolated logs.
- Pilot scope: integrate 1 product line (chat), 2–4 week validation window, simple metrics (latency, cost per 1k tokens, inference errors).

Mutual action items
1) Evelyn/Redwood: send an initial MAP and a pricing estimate for Hosted trial + Dedicated pilot option (attached).
2) Jordan/FinGrid: confirm priority and whether Security/Infra need to be looped for an internal ok.
3) Schedule a 30-min pilot kick-off if we get a green light — link below.

Attachment: FinGrid-MAP-v1.pdf (application/pdf) — mutual action plan + rough timeline

Proposed next step: can you confirm whether this sits high/medium/low on FinGrid's Q4 roadmap? If high/medium we can hold a pilot slot in early Nov.

Thanks — I copied Marissa (CS lead) to help with pilot logistics if/when you want to proceed.

Jordan — passing along the pricing estimate and a short SSO/KMS summary below. Apologies for the delay; pulled the numbers together with Marissa.

Pricing summary (high level)
- Hosted trial (1–2 week): free evaluation credits, then pay-as-you-go; expected token cost ~ $0.018 / 1k tokens for standard model mix during trial.
- Dedicated pilot (4–6 weeks): reserved pilot node, support + quantization tuning included. Ballpark pilot rate: $12k–$18k for the pilot window depending on scale & SLAs.

SSO/KMS checklist (brief)
- SSO: SAML 2.0 supported; we can integrate with Okta/Azure AD.
- KMS: customer key wrapping via AWS KMS or GCP KMS; HSM option for Private deployments.
- Audit: request-level audit logs retained per configurable retention policy.

Attachment: Redwood-Pricing-Est-20261109.pdf (application/pdf)
Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/evelyn-30m — if you want to pick a time for a quick pricing + scope sync.

If your infra/sec team wants more detail we can set a focused call (they can bring specifics). Otherwise, if the budget review is favorable, tell me which pilot lane you'd like and I'll block a slot.

– Evelyn
